answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on time-locked work history, split across independent auditors, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. By the saffron of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The juniper lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the quill is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
